source.pc: In this skill you learn to multiply or divide all terms of an equation by a factor. If you have an equation like then you will be able to instantly multiply all terms by to end up at , or do the reverse. This includes understanding the idea behind this: multiplying both sides of an equation by a factor and subsequently expanding brackets and simplifying any resulting fractions. The skill does not deal with which factor might be wise to multiply/divide by.

source.pc: An equation often consists of multiple terms. The equation for instance has two terms on the left and one term on the right. When rewriting such an equation, a common thing to do is multiply all terms by a factor, or alternatively divide all terms by a factor. We take a look at how and why this works, as well as what short-cuts we can take while doing so.

Wir sehen uns an, wie und warum das funktioniert und welche Abkürzungen wir dabei nehmen können.
